name: coverage-timelines
title: Coverage timelines
description: Paired interval bars on a shared date calendar for each record, showing periods of agreement and uncovered or disputed stretches.
needs: Two date fields marking the start and end of each record's coverage period.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Each {unitOne} has two bars on one calendar: {leftShort} on top, {rightShort} underneath. Where both agree there is a single grey bar. An end sticking out in colour is a stretch of time only one side covers.
text.noDates: No start and end dates were found in these records.

options.name: startField
options.description: Date field key for interval start date.

options.name: endField
options.description: Date field key for interval end date.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: Row order: as sent, by status, or alphabetical by name.

options.name: maxRows
options.description: Draw at most this many records.
